<script lang="ts">
	import { box, mergeProps } from "svelte-toolbelt";
	import type { CheckboxRootProps } from "../types.js";
	import { CheckboxGroupContext, useCheckboxRoot } from "../checkbox.svelte.js";
	import CheckboxInput from "./checkbox-input.svelte";
	import { useId } from "../../../internal/use-id.js";
	import { watch } from "runed";

	let {
		checked = $bindable(false),
		ref = $bindable(null),
		onCheckedChange,
		children,
		disabled = false,
		required = false,
		name = undefined,
		value = "on",
		id = useId(),
		indeterminate = $bindable(false),
		onIndeterminateChange,
		child,
		type = "button",
		...restProps
	}: CheckboxRootProps = $props();

	const group = CheckboxGroupContext.getOr(null);

	if (group && value) {
		if (group.opts.value.current.includes(value)) {
			checked = true;
		} else {
			checked = false;
		}
	}

	watch.pre(
		() => value,
		() => {
			if (group && value) {
				if (group.opts.value.current.includes(value)) {
					checked = true;
				} else {
					checked = false;
				}
			}
		}
	);

	const rootState = useCheckboxRoot(
		{
			checked: box.with(
				() => checked,
				(v) => {
					checked = v;
					onCheckedChange?.(v);
				}
			),
			disabled: box.with(() => disabled ?? false),
			required: box.with(() => required),
			name: box.with(() => name),
			value: box.with(() => value),
			id: box.with(() => id),
			ref: box.with(
				() => ref,
				(v) => (ref = v)
			),
			indeterminate: box.with(
				() => indeterminate,
				(v) => {
					indeterminate = v;
					onIndeterminateChange?.(v);
				}
			),
			type: box.with(() => type),
		},
		group
	);

	const mergedProps = $derived(mergeProps({ ...restProps }, rootState.props));
</script>

{#if child}
	{@render child({
		props: mergedProps,
		...rootState.snippetProps,
	})}
{:else}
	<button {...mergedProps}>
		{@render children?.(rootState.snippetProps)}
	</button>
{/if}

<CheckboxInput />
